runs.name: Pony AI Inc.; Nasdaq PONY (ADS, one Class A share each) since 2024-11-27 and HKEX 2026 since 2025-11-06, SEC CIK 0001969302, a 20-F filer with a December year-end; a Cayman holding company developing autonomous driving technology and selling robotaxi services, robotruck services, and licensing and applications, 97% of 2025 revenue from mainland China through PRC subsidiaries; ten-vote Class B shares; Uber collaboration for Europe 2026-08-14, Sinotrans annual caps revised 2026-08-25; the 20-F names no rival, WeRide and Alphabet's Other Bets read as a CONVENTION of the run
runs.box: TOO HARD (NATURE) AT Q1; integrity facts recorded, not judged
runs.entry: Price **$4.93** a share (Nasdaq close 2026-10-16, aggregator, flagged; HK$45.38 on 2026-10-09 beside). Shares **435,184,160** (354,095,390 Class A and 81,088,770 Class B, no treasury shares, HKEX monthly return for September, 6-K `0001104659-26-114347`, checked against the 20-F cover 433,541,553 and the interim report); cap **$2,145.5M**. Sovereign **2.06%** (PRC Ministry of Finance 30-year government bond curve, compiled and served by China Central Depository and Clearing, 2026-10-16; the earnings currency the RMB, no RMB row in the protocol's table; US Treasury 30-year 5.43% beside). Documents read: the FY2025 20-F (`0001104659-26-046406`, Items 3.D, 4, 5, 6, 10 and the audited statements), the Q2 2026 results and interim announcement (`0001104659-26-098113`), the 2026 interim report (`0001104659-26-109772`) and the 6-Ks of 2026-08-14, 2026-08-25, 2026-10-02, 2026-10-07 and 2026-10-09; FY2022 from the FY2024 20-F XBRL only, declared. Cross-check: FY2025 revenue $90,001K and operating cash $(164,955)K as tagged equal the filed statements. The brief departed in one stated place: the lines of evidence chosen by the analyst from Items 3.D, 4 and 5. **Q1 TOO HARD (NATURE)**: the product is understandable, the ten-year economics are not; the 20-F says "we cannot predict whether we will achieve profitability in the near term or at all" and that past results "are not indicative of future trends"; the key variables (hardware cost, vehicle life, utilization, pricing, a field of well-funded entrants, rules still forming, a technology changed in kind within the company's own life) unforeseeable from the filings; Sinotrans, a related party owning 49% of the subsidiary, 32.9% of 2025 revenue; robotaxi services $12.1M of a $36.2M quarter in Q2 2026; contrary evidence (city unit-economics breakeven in Guangzhou and Shenzhen by the company's own measure, the BYD row OPEN in the framework, the Uber contract) weighed and found volume, not a ten-year fix; NATURE and not WORK because the insiders' own document declines the forecast and no operator in the field has filed a profitable year. Q2 to Q12 not reached; no research pass. Facts after the stop: no borrowings after 2022; cash and securities $1,390.5M at 2026-06-30 ($3.20 a share) against $1,435.5M at 2026-03-31; accumulated deficit up $807M 2022 to 2025; equity raised $104.0M Series D (2023), $408.4M net IPO (2024), $829.4M net Hong Kong listing (2025); the 2025 consolidated loss $76.8M after a $128.0M trading-securities gain, $134.0M attributable; a $25.0M prepayment written off in Q2 2026; WeRide operating losses RMB 779M to RMB 2,185M a year 2022 to 2025, Other Bets $4.1B to $7.5B, Pony gross margin 46.9% to 15.7%. **Integrity facts recorded, not judged**: featured non-GAAP figures excluding stock pay and securities gains, with a new adjustment in Q2 2026 and "Free Cash Flows" defined by the company; ten-vote Class B; the Sinotrans caps raised as insufficient and two new connected agreements; RSUs granted 2026-10-09 with no performance targets. Owner cash (operating cash less stock pay, all capital spending, lease principal and the minority dividend) 2022 to 2025 -180.8, -124.8, -250.2, -247.0, mean -$200.7M equity-only, -$216.4M all-equity before interest income; H1 2026 -176.5 against -110.3; 2024 carries $120.7M of IPO stock pay, means -$170.5M and -$186.2M without it. COMPUTATION, NOT A CLEARANCE: value the no-growth case alone **-$20.94** a share all-equity at 2.06% (-$22.39 equity-only; -$5.96 and -$8.49 at 5.43%) against $4.93; no case earns the floor at any positive price; fair **-$1.78 all-equity** (-$4.61 equity-only); not armed, the box being TOO HARD at Q1. Contamination declared by the analyst: a filtered `Test Runs/` listing showing about thirty other 2026-10-16 run names, the RAIL commit subjects, research-folder names in git status (AYI, ARCB) and the memory index; none about PONY, none used. Commits 717d2fdc (template), 21135c8d (Step 0 to Q1), 85df9f76 (close). Position note filled at the fold: not held. Citations: the analyst's `check_run.py` PASS; the dispatcher's `_fold_cite_check.py` 28 ids, 13 quoted pairs, no slip, no missing id, no E-id. No tracked research file over 200 KB. check_framework PASS. **For the operator** (the analyst's framework notes): (1) Q1 names start-ups as OUT while its routing sends fast-moving technology to TOO HARD, and a never-profitable ten-year-old technology company fits both; (2) specific (b) does not cover a series negative in every year, leaving a one-point range and nothing for Part VII to average; (3) a negative range has no lower bound and the re-look alert cannot be set below zero; (4) no RMB row in the sovereign table, and whether the CCDC-served MOF curve is the issuing authority is not stated; (5) the all-equity basis does not say how to treat interest income of a net-cash company. Could not get: the F-1, 424B4 and Hong Kong prospectus, not read; Baidu's Apollo Go, not reported alone.
runs.narr: TOO HARD (NATURE) at Q1 (a Cayman holding company selling robotaxi and robotruck services and licensing in China through PRC subsidiaries). The product is understandable, the ten-year economics are not: the 20-F cannot say whether the company will ever be profitable and calls its past results not indicative; unit economics, entrants, rules and the technology all unforeseeable; Sinotrans, a related party, 32.9% of 2025 revenue; no operator in the field, WeRide or Alphabet's Other Bets (a CONVENTION of the run), has filed a profitable year. Owner cash negative every year, mean -$200.7M 2022 to 2025, H1 2026 -$176.5M against -$110.3M; no debt, $1,390.5M of cash and securities at 2026-06-30. Integrity facts recorded, not judged: featured non-GAAP with a new Q2 2026 adjustment, ten-vote Class B, Sinotrans caps raised, RSUs without performance targets. COMPUTATION beneath the stop: value -$20.94 a share all-equity at the PRC 30-year 2.06% (no RMB row in the table) against $4.93, no case earning the floor; fair -$1.78 all-equity, -$4.61 equity-only, not armed. Framework gaps for the operator: start-up OUT against technology TOO HARD in Q1, no rule for a series negative every year, a negative range without a lower bound, the RMB sovereign, interest income under the all-equity basis.
